Whenever you achieve at least a Success using Recognise Doctrine, you may immediately attempt Observe Sacred Custom concerning the identified faith or tradition as part of the same action rather than spending its normal 10 minutes.
If your Recognise Doctrine result was Critical, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to this Observe Sacred Custom check.
You must possess sufficient Culture ranks to use Observe Sacred Custom normally.

DEATH INVESTIGATOR.body:
Bruises, blood patterns and the position of a corpse tell you a story long after the victim has stopped speaking.
When using Examine the Dead, reduce the required time from 10 minutes to 1 minute.
In addition, when you achieve at least a Success on Examine the Dead, you gain a +1-circumstance bonus to subsequent Perception, Medicine, Survival or appropriate knowledge checks made to investigate the circumstances of that death.

DOCTRINAL RECALL.body:
Years spent comparing teachings allow you to recognise religious ideas even when they are expressed in unfamiliar language.
When using Recognise Doctrine, you may use Religion, Linguistics or Culture, whichever has the highest bonus. Use the selected skill's ranks to meet the action's Rank requirement.
Furthermore, when you achieve a Success or better on Recognise Doctrine, you gain a +1-circumstance bonus to your next Recall Knowledge or Analyse Scripture check concerning the same doctrine within the next hour.

EXPERT AUTOPSIST.body:
You know how to find the detail that less experienced examiners cut through.
When using Perform Autopsy, a Fumble is treated as a Failure.
On a Critical result, the circumstance bonus granted to a subsequent skill check increases from +2 to +4.
You may also perform an autopsy in 30 minutes rather than 1 hour.

GRAVE VIGIL.body:
You know what a burial ground looks like when everything is where it should be.
You gain a +2-circumstance bonus to Search checks made to notice disturbed graves, opened crypts, damaged funerary seals, concealed entrances within burial structures or physical evidence that a corpse has been moved.
When rolling Initiative within a cemetery, crypt, tomb or similar burial site, you gain a +10-circumstance bonus if an Undead creature, Unliving creature or grave-related hazard is involved in the encounter.

HAUNTWISE.body:
Repeated exposure has taught you that supernatural repetitions have rules, even when those rules are unpleasant.
When you successfully use Interpret Haunt, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to the next saving throw or skill check you make against that haunt within the next hour.
On a Critical result, you may also grant this bonus to one ally who hears your explanation.

KEEPER OF RECORDS.body:
You know where institutions hide information - and which apparently meaningless entry usually reveals it.
When using Research to investigate historical, religious or institutional records, reduce the time required by half.
When using Compare Testaments, a Partial result is treated as a Success for the purpose of determining whether the texts differ, although you still cannot determine which version is older or authoritative unless your actual result would normally allow it.

LAY EXORCIST.body:
You have studied possession as a practical threat rather than a theological abstraction.
You may use Religion instead of Occultism when using Trace Possession or Interpret Haunt. Use your Religion ranks to meet those actions' Rank requirements.
If you achieve a Success or better using Trace Possession against a currently possessed creature, that creature gains a +1-circumstance bonus to its next saving throw to resist or end the possession before the end of its next turn.
This feat identifies and assists against possession; it does not itself Counteract it.

METHODICAL INVESTIGATOR.body:
You have refined one investigative technique until it has become a professional speciality.
Select one of the following actions: Examine the Dead, Interpret Haunt, Recognise Doctrine, Sense Outside Influence, Trace Possession or Trace Religious Provenance.
You gain a +2-class bonus to checks made using the selected action.
You may select Methodical Investigator more than once, choosing a different action each time.

OUTCAST'S RESOLVE.body:
You have already survived condemnation once. Authority no longer possesses quite the same power over you.
Action R; Trigger You fail a Will saving throw against a Fear, Charm or Compulsion effect.
Frequency Once per day
You may reroll the triggering saving throw. You must use the second result.
If the effect originates from a creature, institution, Divine Aspect or religious tradition responsible for your excommunication or rejection, you gain a +1-circumstance bonus to this reroll.

PERFECT PRESERVATION.body:
You can prepare mortal remains for journeys, investigations or funerals that ordinary embalming could never accommodate.
When using Preserve Remains, improve the duration of preservation:
Critical 1 year.
Success 1 month.
Partial 1 week.
You may also perform Preserve Remains using improvised materials at a -2-circumstance penalty rather than requiring a healer's kit.
This remains ordinary preservation and provides no protection against magical decay, animation or destruction.

PILGRIM'S GRACE.body:
Years of entering unfamiliar shrines taught you that respect travels farther than certainty.
When you achieve at least a Success using Observe Sacred Custom, the circumstance bonus granted by that action applies to all appropriate Diplomacy checks involving that religious community for 1 hour rather than only the next check.
Furthermore, after successfully Observing Sacred Custom, you may use Culture instead of Diplomacy to Make an Impression upon a member of that tradition.

RELIC APPRAISER.body:
You have learned to separate sacred history from an enthusiastic seller's story.
You gain a +2-circumstance bonus when using Trace Religious Provenance.
On a Success or better, you can also estimate the object's mundane market value and determine whether its construction, age and provenance are consistent with claims made about it.
On a Critical result, you gain a +1-circumstance bonus to the next Identify Power or Recall Knowledge check made concerning that object. Relic Appraiser does not itself reveal magical properties.

RITE OF PASSING.body:
Your funerary practice gives the bereaved something firm to hold onto while the dead begin their final journey.
You may use Perform instead of Religion when using Perform Last Rites, provided the performance takes the form of an appropriate funeral chant, prayer, lament or ritual recitation. Use your Perform ranks to meet the action's Rank requirement.
Whenever you achieve a Success or better on Perform Last Rites, choose one willing living creature present who knew the deceased. That creature gains a +1-status bonus to saving throws against Fear effects for the next 24 hours.
A creature may benefit from Rite of Passing only once per day.

SACRED POLYGLOT.body:
Religious language is rarely just language; the same word can become law, prayer or accusation depending upon who speaks it.
You gain a +2-circumstance bonus to Linguistics checks involving liturgical languages, ancient religious terminology, sacred names and ritual formulae.
When you successfully Analyse Scripture written in a language you do not speak fluently, you may understand its religious terminology sufficiently to attempt an appropriate Religion or Lore check concerning the text without suffering an additional language penalty.

SANCTIFIED TREATMENT.body:
Prayer does not replace medicine, but discipline, reassurance and careful ritual can make treatment considerably easier to endure.
Whenever you achieve at least a Success using Administer First Aid, Treat Injury or Treat Wounds, the patient gains a +1-circumstance bonus to the next saving throw they attempt against a Disease, Poison or effect with the Soul trait within the next hour.
If your Medicine check is a Critical result, this bonus increases to +2.
A creature can benefit from Sanctified Treatment only once at a time.

SOUL ANCHOR.body:
Through meditation and spiritual discipline, you have learned to distinguish your own consciousness from anything attempting to enter it.
You gain a +1-circumstance bonus to saving throws against possession, Soul Drain and effects that forcibly displace or control your soul.
Whenever you achieve a Critical or Heroic saving throw against possession, you immediately recognise the attempt even if the effect would normally conceal its presence.

SPIRITUAL FORENSICS.prerequisites: Medicine 3 ranks, Occultism or Religion 3 ranks
SPIRITUAL FORENSICS.body:
Physical evidence and supernatural evidence are merely two halves of the same investigation.
Whenever you achieve a Success or better using Examine the Dead or Perform Autopsy, and the corpse shows evidence suggesting possession, Soul Drain, undeath, a Curse or another spiritual affliction, you may immediately attempt either Trace Possession or Identify Spiritual Affliction as part of the same examination.
You still make the second check normally.
If the initial Medicine result was Critical, gain a +2-circumstance bonus to the second check.

SWORN TESTIMONY.body:
Promises have rhythms of their own, and you have heard enough of them to recognise the places where people leave themselves room to escape.
Whenever you deliberately witness a creature make a formal oath, vow, contract or promise, you can accurately recall the significant wording of that declaration for one month.
During that period, you gain a +4-circumstance bonus to Detect Deception checks against that creature when the conversation specifically concerns the terms, meaning or fulfilment of the witnessed promise.
This feat does not reveal whether the creature will ultimately keep the oath.

VEIL LISTENER.body:
You have learned not to assume that every strange feeling is a ghost - and not to assume that it is not.
You gain a +1-circumstance bonus to Trace Possession, Interpret Haunt and Identify Spiritual Affliction checks.
When you achieve a Critical result on any of these actions, you may immediately attempt an appropriate Recall Knowledge check concerning the spirit, haunt or affliction as a Free (0 AP) action.
Veil Listener does not itself allow communication with spirits.

VOICE OF RESOLVE.body:
When fear takes hold, you know exactly what must be said.
Whenever you use Encourage upon an ally suffering from a Fear effect, that ally gains a +2-circumstance bonus to the new saving throw granted by Encourage.
If your Encourage check is a Critical result, the ally also reduces its Frightened condition by 1 after resolving the saving throw.

WATCH THE EYES.body:
People under supernatural influence often control their words more successfully than their smallest involuntary reactions.
When using Sense Outside Influence, treat a Partial result as a Success.
When you achieve a Critical result, you also gain a +2-circumstance bonus to the next Trace Possession or Identify Spiritual Affliction check you make against that creature within the next 10 minutes.
